ABSOLUTE PRIORITY — SUBJECT LIKENESS & IDENTITY:
The main subject(s) in the attached photo must remain unmistakably recognizable. Accurate silhouettes and identity matter more than background decoration.

Identify the real subject(s) in the photo accurately:
- People: Count every person in the foreground/midground and draw every single one with no one omitted, merged, duplicated, or invented. Preserve each person's exact face shape, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, real natural expression (do not force a smile or alter emotion), hairstyle, hair length, parting, bangs, beard, glasses (exact frame shape), real worn accessories (caps, hats, headbands, bows, hair clips, earrings), apparent age, and authentic child or adult body proportions (such as a toddler's round cheeks and larger head-to-body ratio). Never beautify, idealize, slim, age, or cartoon-distort faces. Keep exact relative positions, poses, and heights. Omit blurry accidental strangers far in the background.
- Animals & pets: Preserve exact species and breed, ear/muzzle/tail shape, pose, proportions, and distinct coat or fur color-patch boundaries (outline light vs. dark patches with clean closed lines without filling dark patches in black or scribbles).
- Toys, plushies, dolls & vehicles: Render as an original, simplified hand-drawn children's coloring-book line illustration inspired by the physical toy's recognizable silhouette, proportions, and main structural features. STRICT PACKAGING, BRAND & TEXT CLEANUP: Completely omit all retail cardboard boxes, blister packaging, plastic windows, fabric or price hangtags, barcodes, brand logos, trademarked emblems, and ALL printed text, letters, or numbers—leave toy blocks, cubes, playmats, signs, and vehicle sides completely blank. If a toy appears next to or in front of its retail box, draw ONLY the standalone physical toy once—never draw the box or duplicate illustrations from packaging.
- Landscapes & places: Preserve the recognizable composition, horizon, landmarks, and natural or architectural silhouettes cleanly without inventing extra people.

PRINTABLE COLORING PAGE — STRICT BLACK & WHITE INK RULES:
- 100% pure solid black outlines (#000000) on a pure white (#FFFFFF) background ONLY.
- ZERO color anywhere in the image—including ZERO blue, green, brown, or colored eye irises, ZERO pink cheeks, ZERO tinted accents.
- ZERO grey lines, zero faint or semi-transparent background strokes, zero shading, zero gradients, zero cross-hatching, zero stippling/dot-speckles, zero sketchy double-lines, and zero large solid black filled areas. Render dark hair, dark fur, dark clothing, tyres, and animal eyes as open white colorable shapes with crisp black outlines (keep small white catchlight circles inside pupils so eyes look lively, never solid black holes).
- Every coloring region must be a clean, fully closed shape suitable for crayons, markers, or colored pencils. Simplify dense micro-textures and tiny patterns (individual fur hairs, dense yarn/braid strands, tiny polka dots, dense LEGO brick stud grids, tiny grass blades, fabric weave) into smooth, bold, child-friendly colorable shapes with generous open white space.
- Composition: vertical 3:4 portrait page with open full-bleed white margins—NEVER draw an outer rectangular border, page frame, or corner vignette. Frame the main subject(s) prominently as the grounded hero (about 60-75% of page height) with balanced breathing space so nothing important is clipped when printed on A4. No text, letters, numbers, signatures, frames, or watermarks anywhere.

FAITHFUL PHOTO MODE (NO FANTASY THEME): Translate ONLY the real subject(s), their real pose, their real clothing and worn accessories, and the essential real-world setting from the attached photo into a clean, joyful coloring page.
- Smart background cleanup: If the photo was taken indoors against messy household clutter, shelves, cables, retail boxes, scattered floor toys, or a plain studio surface, replace the distracting clutter with clean open white space, a simple grounding surface line, and only the 1-2 real foreground objects the subject is directly touching or holding. If the photo shows a meaningful outdoor or travel setting (beach, garden, park, mountain, street, landmark), keep that real place recognizable using simplified, bold, uncluttered shapes in crisp solid black lines (never faint grey) that stay visually subordinate and never overpower the main subject.
- Child-friendly clarity: Use bold, smooth outer contours and clean medium inner lines with generous medium-to-large closed coloring areas (simplify dense foliage, knit/yarn strands, tiny polka dots, LEGO stud grids, and complex patterns into clear colorable shapes).
- Strict fidelity guard: DO NOT invent or add any fantasy theme, pirates, ships, unicorns, dragons, knights, space rockets, aliens, dinosaurs, castles, crowns, costume changes, newly invented hats, or imaginary creatures/props not present in the photo.
